name: SLB Edge Blitz Variant
formation: Tampa 2 Shell vs Gun 11 Personnel 2x1 Right
frontName: Under Front, SLB Edge Blitz (Sam/Will Exchange)

summary.motive: Add a fifth rusher off the edge without weakening the Tampa 2 structure by having the Will exchange directly into the Sam’s vacated hook-curl window.
summary.keyDefender: SAM off the edge — the tight end must take the inside LE, leaving the rim completely bare
summary.whyItWorks: The offense’s hot rule sends its quickest answer straight into the zone the blitzing defender just abandoned — where the Will is now waiting.
summary.failureMode: A max-protect shift or back releases the back to the edge, turning the free runner into a blocked hat and stranding the exchange.

beats.title: 1. The Walk-Up Edge Threat
beats.text: SAM stands walked wide at 4 yards off the tight end with the four-man shell otherwise untouched — one extra body the protection math cannot hide.

beats.title: 2. Free Rusher Off the Rim
beats.text: The LE pins the tight end low so SAM turns the corner unblocked while the interior trio keeps the pocket compressed from the middle.

beats.title: 3. The Zone Exchange Behind It
beats.text: WILL has slid across into SAM’s vacated hook-curl, eyes jumping instantly to the designed hot answer in that exact window.

beats.title: 4. Hot Answer Picked
beats.text: The panic throw into Sam’s old zone lands in the exchanging WILL’s hands — pressure and coverage trading places in one call.

relations.tell: The Sam linebacker stands upright at 4 yards staring at the tackle’s outside shoulder — the base Tampa 2 keeps him stacked over the tight end at 4.5.
